note: Isometric ground blocks extracted AS-IS (not un-skewed). Each tile is a 2:1 diamond TOP face plus extruded sides below. Diamond metrics measured on the representative tile asphalt.png (128x81): top-diamond apex at (apexX,apexY)=(64,0), left vertex (0,32), right vertex (127,32), bottom vertex (64,64). diamondW/diamondH describe the walkable top face that tessellates on an iso grid. Tiles were alpha-trimmed of fully-transparent borders only; the full block (top+sides) is intact. apexY is 0 for all tiles except dirt.png whose apex pixel is at y=1 due to one extra faint antialiased row (height 82).
